adversarial.text: French Guiana, Martinique, Guadeloupe, Falkland Islands/Malvinas, Anguilla, Montserrat, Bonaire and Saint Barthelemy are unrecognized (0, no reason), and all are small-population Latin American/Caribbean places. Bare 'Guiana' even fuzzy-matches Guyana. Puerto Rico and other territories are handled correctly.
adversarial.suggestion: Add extras: French Guiana/Martinique/Guadeloupe ("an overseas department of France"), Falkland Islands with aliases Falklands/Malvinas ("a British Overseas Territory"), Anguilla/Montserrat ("a British Overseas Territory"), Bonaire ("part of the Netherlands"), Saint Barthelemy ("a French overseas collectivity").

adversarial.text: 'Salvador' (common shorthand for El Salvador, ~6.3M, a valid answer) is unrecognized.

adversarial.text: 'Dominican' fuzzy-matches Dominica (1 edit), not the Dominican Republic, and 'Dom Rep' is unrecognized. The Dominican Republic (~$120B) is a valid answer to 'GDP over $100 billion', but a player who types 'Dominican' is scored as Dominica (~$0.6B) and busts.
adversarial.suggestion: Add aliases to DOM: "Dominican", "Dom Rep", "DR", "Dominican Rep".
